harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (covering all/default/enp1s0 scopes plus secure_redirects), applied live, and verified persistence across a full node reboot with a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values (accept_redirects=1, accept_source_route=0) on node1
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0, secure_redirects=0 for all/default scopes
Applied via sudo sysctl --system

Discovered enp1s0 per-interface accept_redirects still showed 1 (pre-existing interface not covered by all/default at parse time); set it live with sysctl -w and appended enp1s0-specific lines to the persistent config file
Verified live all/default/enp1s0 values are 0 for accept_redirects and accept_source_route
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline
Issued sudo systemctl reboot via backgrounded nohup so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming connection timeout/reset during the down window
Confirmed new boot_id (b5417ee9-...) and new boot time (08:26:20), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified all hardening sysctl values remained 0 post-reboot and confirmed the persistent config file contents were intact

evidence.requirement: Baseline: ICMP redirects were accepted (accept_redirects=1) before hardening
Persistent config file created for IPv4 redirect/source-route hardening
evidence.summary: Wrote and later appended to /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf covering all/default/enp1s0 accept_redirects, accept_source_route, and secure_redirects

sysctl --system reload showed accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all/default; per-interface enp1s0 accept_redirects/secure_redirects explicitly set to 0 since it predated the all/default write

evidence.requirement: Live verification that all scopes (all/default/enp1s0) show hardened values before restart
evidence.summary: /proc/sys and sysctl reads confirmed accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 across all, default, and enp1s0 scopes

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + config state)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 and uptime 2026-09-03 08:24:54 alongside healthy hardened sysctl values

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded nohup, command returned exit_code 0 with pid before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 became unreachable during restart, then exec availability recovered
evidence.summary: First two polls timed out/reset (node down); third poll succeeded, proving exec came back online

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity confirming an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id b5417ee9-e906-4d0b-b312-d0f5577fb577 and new uptime 08:26:20 differ from pre-restart boot_id e625b9a5-..., proving a real reboot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: hardened IPv4 settings persisted across reboot
evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl reads confirmed accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all/default/enp1s0, and the persistent config file /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf still contained all hardening lines
